cueCard.topic: Describe a time when you were very busy.
cueCard.explain: and explain how you felt during this busy time.

questions.text: Describe a time when you were very busy.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you were very busy. You should say: when it was; what you had to do; how you organised your time; and explain how you felt during this busy time.
Thank you. Do you enjoy being busy?

questions.text: Do people in your country work longer hours than in the past?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you were very busy, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all work and free time. Do people in your country work longer hours than in the past?

questions.text: Why is it important to have a balance between work and free time?
